issues.title: BLU-012 Teach Mode capture session lifecycle

criteria.requirement: Opt-in Teach Mode never captures denied or unknown apps; cancel destroys uncommitted steps; a restarted session remains off and empty.

tests.name: ac1 cancel drops captured steps and restart stays off

criteria.requirement: Fake-host tests cover successful capture, malformed input, expiry, cancellation in flight, revoked permissions, offline failure, capture error and restart without implicit resume.

tests.name: ac2 denied or unknown app pauses until user resumes
ac2 timeout expires and destroys uncommitted observations
ac2 offline and permission revocation terminate capture
ac2 concurrent start cancelled mid-check never resurrects
ac2 capture errors pause and require explicit resume
ac2 cancellation fences in-flight result and restart is off
ac2 malformed capture results are refused without retention

criteria.requirement: Teach Mode retains only validated identifiers, rejects secret payloads and unapproved I/O, and produces non-executable drafts requiring separate approval.

tests.name: ac3 secret-bearing input discarded and draft cannot execute
ac3 teach capture retains no payloads and uses no io or network

criteria.requirement: A mounted Flutter Teach Mode UI shows active, paused and off from the real session, responds to denied/permission changes and cancel or restart, and never misidentifies ordinary screen watching.

tests.name: teach mode indicator shows active paused and off on revoke cancel restart
ordinary watching never becomes Teach Mode and cannot be cancelled by teaching
